title: Control Plane: weekly spot-check and burn catalog
summary: Lightweight weekly spot-check covering control plane health, routing fallthroughs, auth latencies, and quota billing anomalies. Focus this week: clarify quota backfill plan and ship hotfix for auth token refresh race.
notes:
Purpose: rapid triage + concrete next steps.

1) Control plane health: cluster-2 saw recurring 5xx spikes on 2026-05-25 18:40 - observed by tracing. Root cause suspected: ephemeral allocator loop entering a retry storm when a subset of hosts returned 503s.
- PR to instrument backoff counters merged (allocator PR #987). Still rolling to staging.
- Temporary mitigation: increase per-host retry jitter (config flag). Priya to flip on flag in canary region tonight.

2) Routing & fallthroughs: recent customer reports of unexpected model fallthroughs when capacity was low and fallback policy selected incompatible quantized variant.
- Observed behavior: router fallback selects model variant with incompatible vocab size causing inference failures.
- Short-term: add validation check in routing decision path to ensure vocab and kv-cache compatibility. Arjun to open PLAT-4898.
- Long-term: expand model metadata surfaced to router and add regression tests.

3) Auth latency spike: token refresh path shows >200ms tail latency under bursty flows, correlated with lock contention in local cache refresh path.
- Sofia identified lock window and proposed optimistic refresh (compare-and-swap) approach. Prototype merged to staging.
- Hotfix: revert stale-cache backoff to 50ms and deploy to low-traffic cluster. Sofia to coordinate rollout.

4) Quotas & billing anomalies: accounting pipeline shows ~2% discrepancy for dedicated customers during high write throughput windows. Suspected double-counting from duplicate ack path on retry.
- Liam reproduced locally and filed PLAT-4823 with repro steps.
- Action: add idempotency token to quota write and a reconciliation job to backfill last 72 hours. Reconciliation ETA: 3 days.
decisions:
- Apply jittered retry mitigation in cluster-2 as temporary fix.
- Router will reject fallback variants that mismatch runtime metadata (vocab/kv schema).
- Implement optimistic token refresh (Sofia's approach) before next canary.
- Run quota reconciliation for last 72 hours and monitor billing alerts.
